description: This is a Java test class for the InboundMappingProcessor, containing unit tests for message mapping, dropping, filtering, and error handling in messaging-based connectivity using mocks and assertions.

classes.name: InboundMappingProcessorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing various scenarios of the InboundMappingProcessor, including message mapping, dropping, filtering, and error cases.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem, logger, and configuration before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Prepares the mappings and the InboundMappingProcessor instance before each test.

methods.name: testInboundMessageMapped
methods.description: Tests processing of a typical inbound message that should be successfully mapped.

methods.name: testInboundMessageWithCondition
methods.description: Tests processing of an inbound message with a correlation ID condition.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDropped
methods.description: Tests that messages using the dropping mapper are dropped (not processed further).

methods.name: testInboundMessageDuplicated
methods.description: Tests handling of a message that should be duplicated according to the duplicating mapper.

methods.name: testInboundMappingFails
methods.description: Simulates and verifies behavior when mapping a message fails.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDroppedFailedMappedDuplicated
methods.description: Tests complex scenario where messages are dropped, failed, mapped, and duplicated with multiple mappers.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDroppedForHonoEmptyNotificationMessagesWithDefaultMapper
methods.description: Verifies that Hono empty notification messages are dropped with default mapping.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDroppedForHonoEmptyNotificationMessagesWithDittoMapper
methods.description: Verifies dropping behavior with Ditto-specific mapper for Hono empty notifications.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDroppedForHonoEmptyNotificationMessagesWithDittoByAliasMapper
methods.description: Verifies dropping of empty notifications with Ditto by alias mapping.

methods.name: testInboundFailedForHonoEmptyNotificationMessagesWithCustomDittoMapper
methods.description: Tests that failed processing occurs for custom Ditto mapper on empty notifications.

methods.name: testInboundMessageDroppedForCustomContentType
methods.description: Verifies dropping behavior for messages with a custom content type.

methods.name: testInbound
methods.description: Helper method to test various inbound message scenarios with specified expectations.

methods.name: testInboundWithCor
methods.description: Helper method to test inbound messages with specific correlation headers.

methods.name: testInbound (overloaded)
methods.description: Main method to execute a test case for an ExternalMessage, verifying the number of mapped, dropped, and failed outcomes.
